section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes instruments used in the study, including a newly developed Caregiver Eating Messages Scale (CEMS) that was piloted with 43 college students, the Family subscale of the Body Acceptance by Others Scale (BAOS) for perceived familial acceptance, the 13-item Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) for body appreciation, the Intuitive Eating Scale (IES), and computation of BMI from self-reported height and weight. The text references a pilot sample of 43 college students (12 men, 31 women; M age = 26.40) but does not label any study as 'Study 1' or enumerate multiple studies.
